name: Elda Ballad
source:
She is aggressive in her pursuit of the protagonist in order to get pregnant, believing it to be the best way to continue the dark elf race.

Her language is coarse and she belongs to the armed unit of the dark elf army, she is known for swinging her axe around wildly. However, deep down she wants to dress ladylike.

[spoiler]1804 years old.[/spoiler]
